msg: The aim of the game is to choose the gnome that has the gold basket.  Be careful because the gnome with the red basket will result in losing points.  Press S to choose the gnome on your left and K for the gnome on your right.  Be quick as 1.5 seconds isn't long to make your choice.The basket is where you gather points, which in turn means pounds!!  Time is not on your side so be quick in pressing that space bar to collect your points.  The gold basket will add points whereas the red basket will lose points.  The more points you collect, the more money that will be in the prize pot at the end.HINT: Choose the more natural coloured gnomes for the gold baskets which should provide you with the best chance to win big money.  Enjoy the game and best of luck in seeking out the gold baskets!
